definitions.explanation: A formal or official term for rainy weather. Commonly seen in announcements and signage about weather-dependent events.

examples.japanese: {雨天|うてん}⟦{中止|ちゅうし}→中止：03481_chuushi⟧。
{雨天|うてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体育館|たいいくかん}→体育館：03111_taiikukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}います→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: In the event of rain, it will be held in the gymnasium.

examples.japanese: {雨天|うてん}⟦{決行|けっこう}→決行：02794_kekkou⟧です⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{持|も}ち→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: The event will proceed rain or shine, so please bring an umbrella.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word seen mostly in written announcements, event notices, and weather reports. In everyday conversation, ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧ is used instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雨天|うてん}⟦{中止|ちゅうし}→中止：03481_chuushi⟧ (canceled in case of rain)
- {雨天|うてん}⟦{決行|けっこう}→決行：02794_kekkou⟧ (will proceed rain or shine)
- {雨天|うてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧ (in the event of rain)
- {雨天|うてん}⟦{順延|じゅんえん}→順延：15354_junen⟧ (postponed to the next clear day)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{雨天|うてん} is formal/written; ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧ is the everyday word. {雨天|うてん} appears on signs and posters, not in casual speech.
